=== PAGE 1 ===
LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT
OF
ROBERT JAMES JOHNSON

I, Robert James Johnson, a resident of the County of San Diego, State of California, being of sound mind and memory and not acting under duress, menace, fraud, or the undue influence of any person, do hereby make, publish, and declare this instrument to be my Last Will and Testament. I hereby revoke all wills and codicils previously made by me.

ARTICLE I. DECLARATIONS
I have three children now living, namely Emily Johnson, David Johnson and Sarah Johnson. All references in this Will to "my children" are to the persons named above.

ARTICLE II. PAYMENT OF DEBTS AND EXPENSES
I direct my Executor to pay from my estate all of my legally enforceable debts, the expenses of my last illness and funeral, and the expenses of administering my estate.

ARTICLE III. TANGIBLE PERSONAL PROPERTY
I give all of my tangible personal property, including household furniture, jewelry, automobiles, and personal effects, to my children who survive me, to be divided among them as they shall agree.

ARTICLE IV. RESIDUARY ESTATE
I give the residue of my estate, being all property, real and personal, wherever situated, not otherwise effectively disposed of, in equal shares to my children, Emily Johnson, David Johnson and Sarah Johnson. If any child of mine fails to survive me, that child's share shall pass to his or her then living issue, by right of representation.

My brokerage account at LPL Financial shall pass as part of my residuary estate.

=== PAGE 2 ===
ARTICLE V. EXECUTOR
I nominate and appoint my brother, Thomas Johnson, as Executor of this Will. If he fails to qualify or ceases to act, I nominate my daughter, Emily Johnson, as alternate Executor. No bond shall be required of any Executor nominated in this Will.

ARTICLE VI. POWERS OF EXECUTOR
My Executor shall have full power to sell, lease, or encumber any property of my estate, public or private, with or without notice, and to administer my estate under the Independent Administration of Estates Act.

ARTICLE VII. GOVERNING LAW
This Will shall be construed and administered under the laws of the State of California.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have signed this Will on March 14, 2019, at San Diego, California.

/s/ Robert James Johnson
Robert James Johnson, Testator

ATTESTATION
On the date written above, Robert James Johnson declared to us that this instrument was his Will and signed it in our presence. We now sign as witnesses in his presence and in the presence of each other. Each of us is over eighteen years of age.

/s/ Angela Reyes, residing at San Diego, California
/s/ Mark Whitfield, residing at La Jolla, California
